why: A record that is fresh in the GRID and stale in the WAYS. Every number in this `walk-record.json` is a real hash of a real gallery build: the grid hash and the blockout hash are this point's own, and the `layout_graph_sha256` is the site-plan overlay's — a different whole, with different beats, a different critical path and a different flag on its gated way, standing on a grid and a massing that this point's own hash to. So the record names a walk that happened, of a map this is not, and every hash taken over GEOMETRY agrees that nothing moved. The whole a walk judges is the space AND the rules a body moves through it by, and the grid is only the first: a node's `size_class` is a sky-open box's headroom, a seam is cut to air or filled with the bar by its edge's `class`, the side an `anchor/unlock-…` stands on is its `opens_from`, what a body must hold to pass is its `gating`, and where a body starts, which route it is meant to take and which places its beats happen in are the graph's alone. None of that is a cell. It declares no unit: every field these documents use is written in the site-plan overlay and compiles there, so there is nothing to exempt — what must not compile is detail work standing on a walk of a different whole.
